g.text: TLS, verified account identity, distributed quotas
policy review, independent evaluation and incident response
Any failed gate stops the turn. No draft streaming.
Models cannot grant roles, publish documents or change policy.
Default: same model for generation and judging.
Logical role separation is not process isolation or independent accuracy.
Loopback transport does not attest offline inference.
